title: Oven-Warmed Irish Monsoon Stew
description: Savory, crisp monsoon-inspired Irish stew flavored with cider and featuring confit-tomatoes, served in scallop shells. Perfect for a cold Irish night.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the confit-tomatoes, scallion and garlic scapes, Irish cider vinegar, olive oil, sea salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Toss to combine and season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
In a large baking dish, arrange the sliced red potatoes, cabbage, and red onion in the bottom of the dish.
Pour the tomato mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Transfer the baking dish to a preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the dish from the oven and carefully place the scallop shells on top of the stew.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the scallop shells are lightly browned and fragrant.
Serve the stew hot in the scallop shells, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the stew rest for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Strain the juices from the baking dish and discard the solids.
Serve the juices alongside the stew.
Use leftover stew for future meals.
